meta.name: description
meta.content: RAJ ENGINE GAME - A 3D vertical parkour and climbing obstacle game created by @raj_dev_01

div.div: Don't give up — get back to the climb!

div.style: text-align:left; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; max-height:50vh; overflow-y:auto; width:100%; margin-bottom:14px;
div.p: 🚀 SUPER JUMP (Key 1): Massive vertical rocket leap.
💨 AIR DASH (Key Q): High-speed horizontal burst in mid-air.
🏃‍♂️ WALL RUN (Key 2): Run along smooth walls for up to 3s.
🧗‍♂️ WALL CLIMB / GRAB (Key E / Hold Jump): Scale vertical walls and grab ledges.
🛡️ SHIELD (Key 3): Protects against hazards and heavy impacts.
🌌 GRAVITY BOOST (Key 4): Floats player with reduced gravity.
🧲 LEDGE MAGNET (Passive): Snaps safely to nearby ledges.

RAJ ENGINE GAME is a standalone 3D vertical parkour and climbing simulation built with pure WebGL, Three.js, and Web Audio API.
Scale from 0m to 1000m across 3 challenging rounds, unlocking futuristic abilities and surviving dynamic hazards!
